# JSON.fit

> JSON.fit is a free workout and nutrition app for skinny guys who can't gain weight. 80+ calorie-dense, high-protein bulking meals with every ingredient and step, built for batch prep so a week of food comes off one shop and one short prep session. Free printable cookbook, free periodised training programs, no subscription, no account, no ads. Answer a few questions and the app builds your whole week of meals and your training program in seconds, around your calories, protein and the food you like. No AI needed; you can optionally bring your own AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) for meals outside the library.

JSON.fit specialises in calorie-dense, high-protein bulking meals with full ingredients and step-by-step cooking, designed for batch prep so a week of food gets handled in one session. Includes periodised muscle-building training programs that run up to a full year. Built for skinny guys with full-time jobs who want results without bulking becoming a second job. Data stays on device. iOS and Android. Built by Ryan Novinc, who is bulking from 77 kg to 90 kg on the app in public.

## Who this is for

Skinny guys with full-time jobs, businesses, or active social lives who want to gain weight and build muscle without bulking taking over their week. The app is built around batch meal prep, one weekly shop, and minimal mental load, so eating in a surplus fits around real life instead of taking it over.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://json.fit/): The meals, how the app builds your week, training, research and FAQ. Primary reference page.
- [The Lab](https://json.fit/lab): The founder's public bulk, 77 kg to 90 kg, with monthly body scans and progress photos.
- [Free bulking cookbook](https://json.fit/cookbook/): "The Skinny Guy's Bulking Cookbook", 80+ calorie-dense meals as a printable PDF. Free in exchange for an email.
- [Meal library](https://json.fit/meals.html): Browse 80+ high-protein bulking meals with macros, exact ingredients, and step-by-step cooking. Designed for cook-once-eat-all-week meal prep.
- [Training programs](https://json.fit/programs/): Free periodised muscle-building programs (beginner to advanced) that import directly into the app, no programming knowledge required.

## Guides

- [Blog](https://json.fit/blog.html): Bulking and training articles for skinny guys with full-time jobs.
- [Build a custom meal plan with Claude](https://json.fit/blog/meal-plan-claude.html): Optional: have your own AI write a custom plan and import it into JSON.fit.
